blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – An 11-year-old boy fell asleep during a family visit in an air-conditioned bedroom, unaware that a quiet violation behind closed doors would leave him haunted long after the incident. Overwhelmed by fear of an older relative, the little boy complied when his 25-year-old paternal aunt ordered him to undress. He remained silent at first—bound by youth, curiosity, and fear—only to carry a crushing weight of guilt and shame afterward.
